newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl adjusted 9-mo sales down 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl adjusted 9-mo sales down 8 pct.

text.p: Austrian steel firm VA Stahl said on Monday sales in the first nine months fell eight percent against the previous year, adjusted to exclude trading firm Voest-Alpine Intertrading.
Clarifying its earlier results statement, VA Stahl said sales to the end of September fell to 23.6 billion schillings from 25.7 billion schillings at the same time last year.
"As Voest-Alpine Intertrading is not included in the 23.6 billion schillings figure, one should take 25.7 billion as the comparative," VA Stahl said.
Last year VA Stahl posted nine-month sales of 32.4 billion schillings, including Intertrade. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
